snippet.title: Slide Soldiers - Sliding Puzzles with a Twist! - Steam December 2026
snippet.description:
Slide Soldiers is a cozy sliding puzzle game where the goal is to get all the enemies rather than reach an exit.
There’s no rush to complete puzzles. You can choose from multiple difficulties and modes to customize your experience, making this the perfect "brain off" or "brain on" game.
In this reimagined genre, the shortest path to victory is right through your enemies!

Releasing: December 1st, 2026 on Steam
Languages: English, 简体中文, Русский

🎮 Wishlist Slide Soldiers Today! 🧩
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3923050/Slide_Soldiers/

Game Features:
   - A chill experience that you can take at your own pace
   - A new twist on sliding puzzles where the goal is to defeat all the enemies
   - 5,000 pre-generated levels
   - Levels ranging from easy to hard, each with a perfect path
   - Play the game from a new perspective in Adventure Mode
   - Hand-drawn art style
   - Relaxing soundtrack

Additional Information
https://distractedcoder.com/slide-soldiers/

Credits:
Trailer music composed by @ScottyRichMusic
